rotation: Top five team-specific total minutes; all five play the full fixed-possession game, no bench substitutions. This is conditional fixed-five PR, not full-rotation NBA team PR.

methodology.ability: Full-season player totals including all traded-team stints; selection and tendencies use team-specific totals. No team wins, net rating, usage targets or card costs enter ratings.
methodology.shooting: Inverse engine accuracy curves after 100-attempt league-prior shrinkage, bounded 40..99; FT curve unchanged.
methodology.defense: Tracked opponent percentage difference shrunk by D_FGA/(D_FGA+200), inverse defense curves, bounded 40..99.
methodology.other: Rank within GP>=30 and MPG>=20 pool, attribute PR1/50/99 -> 40/70/99.
methodology.unknown: offBall, screen, handle and breakDbl set to neutral 70: unmeasured, not fabricated individual ratings.
methodology.roles: Height ascending assigns PG/SG/SF/PF/C; AST/min and player ID break ties. This is an explicit role convention, not official starting positions.
